# UNM Center for Advanced Research Computing

> The UNM Center for Advanced Research Computing (CARC): mission, research, the CSE certificate program, news, open positions, and contact information. User documentation for CARC systems lives at https://carc.unm.edu/docs/ (with its own llms.txt). The source repository is an Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle: every page carries YAML frontmatter with type, provenance, and lifecycle fields.

Full corpus for ingestion: https://carc.unm.edu/llms-full.txt

Every page's Markdown source (OKF frontmatter included) is served at its URL plus `index.md` — for example https://carc.unm.edu/about/mission/index.md. Agent guide: https://carc.unm.edu/docs/about/ai-agents/

## About CARC

- [History](https://carc.unm.edu/about/history/): A timeline of CARC milestones from the founding of the Maui and Albuquerque high performance computing centers in the 1990s through recent system donations and retirements.
- [Internal Advisory Board](https://carc.unm.edu/about/iab/): Membership roster and meeting minutes of the CARC Internal Advisory Board, which meets regularly to make decisions regarding the center's operations and goals.
- [Mission and vision](https://carc.unm.edu/about/mission/): CARC's vision and mission: leading and growing the computational research community at UNM.
- [Strategic plan](https://carc.unm.edu/about/strategic-plan/): An overview of CARC's strategic plan to meet user needs and develop a sustainable funding model, with a link to the full plan PDF.

## Research

- [Featured projects](https://carc.unm.edu/research/featured-projects/): Feature articles highlighting research projects done using computing, storage, and support resources at the Center for Advanced Research Computing.
- [Free research computing](https://carc.unm.edu/research/free-services/): A description of the free baseline research computing service CARC provides to UNM main campus users, including the core-hour and storage limits.
- [Grant writing resources](https://carc.unm.edu/research/grant-resources/): Links to UNM training, funding search, proposal development, compliance, and submission resources for researchers writing grant proposals, plus the CARC facilities description for proposals.
- [Premium services](https://carc.unm.edu/research/premium-services/): CARC's UNM-approved cost model for condo cluster nodes, VM hosting, dedicated storage, and custom support for users whose needs exceed the free baseline service.
- [Publications and acknowledgement](https://carc.unm.edu/research/publications/): The acknowledgement statement to use in publications that made use of CARC resources — ready to copy and paste — plus how to register your publication and a link to publications that feature the center.

## Education & training

- [Workshops and seminars](https://carc.unm.edu/education/workshops/): Free CARC workshops in the 1601 Central workshop room, the live events calendar, and video alternatives.

## CSE Certificate Program

- [CSE application](https://carc.unm.edu/education/cse/application/): How to apply to the CSE Certificate Program through the UNM ApplyYourself portal.
- [Electives and participating departments](https://carc.unm.edu/education/cse/electives/): Approved CSE elective courses by department — with live schedule links and Fall 2026 offering status — and the departments participating in the certificate program.
- [CSE program requirements](https://carc.unm.edu/education/cse/requirements/): Admission prerequisites, core courses, elective hours, and the research project requirement for the CSE certificate.
- [Program specializations](https://carc.unm.edu/education/cse/specializations/): Optional, non-transcripted CSE specializations: Computational Fluid Dynamics and Data Science.

## Jobs

- [Postdoctoral Researcher — Agentic AI](https://carc.unm.edu/jobs/postdoc-agentic-ai/): Lead the agentic AI orchestration prototype for the NSF MESA project at CARC: self-hosted LLM serving, retrieval over scientific metadata, and the MCP server framework. 1.0 FTE.
- [Program Manager](https://carc.unm.edu/jobs/program-manager/): Manage the $4.6M NSF MESA cooperative agreement at CARC: execution plan, schedule and budget tracking, risk register, and coordination across three institutions. 1.0 FTE.
- [Research Computing Facilitator](https://carc.unm.edu/jobs/research-computing-facilitator/): Consult with UNM research groups, build and maintain Linux systems, install scientific software, and bring labs onto CARC's HPC and cloud platforms. 1.0 FTE, posted as Systems/Network Analyst 2.

## Contact

- [Office and consultation hours](https://carc.unm.edu/contact/office-hours/): Weekly open office hours with CARC staff on Zoom (Tuesdays and Thursdays, 11:00–12:00 MT) and how to book a longer consultation.
- [Personnel](https://carc.unm.edu/contact/personnel/): The CARC team: leadership, systems staff, and administration.
- [Visiting CARC](https://carc.unm.edu/contact/visiting/): Location, directions, and parking for the CARC building at 1601 Central Avenue NE.
